Ravi (People Ops): Quick ask  can we build a super-short goal + feedback paste for managers to drop into 1:1 agendas? Needs to be copy/paste friendly and usable in 10-15m check-ins.
Anna P: Yes please. Keep it to 6 lines per goal so it fits into calendar notes.
Tom H: Include a single-line 'impact' prompt. Engineers often forget to tie work to outcomes.
Mei L: Add a tiny feedback script: Evidence > Impact > Next step. Maybe a one-sentence example.
Ravi (People Ops): Draft below  tell me if anything missing.
Ravi (People Ops): ```
Manager pre-check: aligned? metric? blockers?
Goal (one line): "Ship X to reduce Y by Z% (metric)"
Why: 1-line business/customer impact
This sprint: 2 actions (owner + date)
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers / deps (owner + ETA)
Ask from manager: specific help needed
Feedback script: "When you did X I saw Y; that led to Z. Try A next time."
Calibration note (for private doc): Outcome / Signals / Suggested note
```
FeedbackBot: Tip: pre-fill the template before the 1:1 to keep meeting time for coaching.
Anna P: I'll pilot this in my team's weekly sync and report back.
Tom H: Add a short stretch goal line maybe. Otherwise good to ship.
Ravi (People Ops): Will add stretch line and post in the performance kickoff doc. Thanks all :tada:
